Kelly M: Hi @people-ops — I need to request a temporary compressed workweek (4x10) and a partial on-call exemption for ~8 weeks starting next Monday due to a medical treatment schedule. Can someone outline what documentation you need and how on-call coverage would work? I'm happy to DM sensitive details.
Sara P: Thanks for reaching out, Kelly. We can support a temporary compressed schedule and adjust on-call coverage. Please DM a high-level accommodation request and upload a medical note to accommodations@redwood.com (confidential). We'll coordinate coverage and update your performance metrics for the period.
Dave T: Kelly — I can take point on coverage. I propose rotating your on-call with Priya and Marco and moving you to pager-read-only during the 8 weeks. I'll update the rota and remove any late-night escalations for you.
Kelly M: Appreciate it, Dave. Quick question — will this affect my mid-cycle performance review or any deliverable deadlines? Want to avoid surprises.
Sara P: We do not use accommodations against performance. Operationally, we can add a note to the performance record indicating this temporary adjustment and ask managers to mark affected sprint commitments as deferred where appropriate. Manager sign-off is required to adjust deadlines.
Dave T: I sign off on excluding on-call uptime/response metrics for Kelly for the specified 8 weeks and will talk to Eng Leads about pushing noncritical deadlines.
People Ops Bot: People Ops Bot: New accommodation request created: ACCOM-2024-342. (Private link: https://redwood.accoms/ACCOM-2024-342)
Kelly M: Thanks — I'm uploading the doctor's note now to the private upload and will DM a brief context. Would be great to have a two-week check-in after the start to make sure coverage is working. :pray:
Sara P: Got it. We'll draft an accommodation letter outlining the 4x10 schedule, on-call adjustments, and the 8-week review. Expect an official note by EOD Friday. We can schedule the 2-week check-in now if you'd like.
Kelly M: Yes please — add me for a 20m check-in two weeks after the start. Thanks everyone for the fast help.
Sara P: Done — calendar invite sent. If anything changes sooner, DM us. All communications about medical details will stay confidential per our policy.
